description: LiveSpot is an independent Swedish event guide. Ask in plain language - "what's on in Gothenburg this weekend", "concerts in Stockholm under 500 SEK" - and get current events with venue, date, price and a direct link to book. Search by free text, city, category, date range or budget; open full event details with description, venue, availability and ticket links; browse by city or category; and find similar events to one you like. Covers concerts, theatre, musicals, dance, comedy, sport, festivals and family events across Sweden, collected daily from 13 ticketing providers. Free and read-only: no account, no API key.
